title: Jim Bob Cooter on Seth McGowan and playing in Jacksonville | Colts at Jaguars, Week 8
headline: Cooter says rookie RB Seth McGowan has earned extra carries over recent weeks by running hard, while the offense, Daniel Jones included, and the pass protection need to get cleaner against Jacksonville.
summary: Asked what Daniel Jones must fix to get back to his 2025 level, Cooter spread the blame across the whole offense, including his own play-calling. He listed protection, routes, footwork, decisions and overall operation as areas to improve. He credited last week's opponent with a tough defense that stresses the pass game, and said the team needs to keep refining fundamentals and earn its confidence. On Jacksonville's losing-streak history for visitors, he dismissed any mystique and called it just a streak. He added that he used to work out of that stadium, which is being renovated. He praised rookie RB Seth McGowan as a hard runner who has been given a few extra opportunities in recent weeks and made the most of them. He said McGowan turns 1-2 yard gains into 3-4 yard gains and sometimes into 10-12 yard gains, and that the staff is pleased with him. He stressed that McGowan is still a young player who has not been perfect. On protection issues, Cooter said the fix is wholesale: better preparation, fundamentals and technique, plus scheme help such as adjustments to blitz and protection plans. He was deliberately vague on specifics. He noted that opponents have identified tendencies on tape and countered them over the last few weeks.

signals.claim: McGowan will keep earning carries after getting extra opportunities over the last several weeks.
signals.note: The rookie RB has an expanding role, and the coaching staff trusts his hard running, which makes him a flex or handcuff option to watch.

signals.claim: The offense, including Jones, needs to improve protection, footwork and decisions to return to its 2025 level.
signals.note: Cooter gave no specific fix and spread the blame, so Jones's fantasy outlook depends on protection improving against Jacksonville.
signals.quote: we all got to get better. You know, I got to do a better job

topics.detail: Cooter called the fix wholesale: fundamentals, technique and scheme help to the blitz and protection plans. He said opponents have put tendencies on tape and countered them in recent weeks.
He downplayed the Jaguars' home-streak narrative, saying a streak is just a streak. He plans a good week of practice and mentioned working out of that stadium, which is being renovated.
Cooter said every rep builds or erodes the coaching staff's confidence in a young player. McGowan earned his carries through his offseason and training camp work.
